description: Image Description: The image depicts a large, white boat docked alongside an industrial waterfront. The boat appears weathered and aged, with visible rust spots and peeling paint along its hull. The vessel is moored in calm water, with a brick industrial building in the background. The building has several large windows and a flat roof. There is some greenery, including a tree and shrubs, visible near the building. The sky is overcast with a few clouds, suggesting a cloudy day.
